title: DeckDiligenceExtractionTemplate
description: Standardized schema for objective pitch deck quantitative extraction. Use null for any undisclosed metric (never extrapolate or invent defaults). Record slide citations for auditability.

company_overview.tagline: Brief description of company value proposition

team.name: Jane Doe
team.background: Ex-Product Lead at Stripe; BS Computer Science (MIT).

team.name: John Smith
team.background: Ex-Staff Infrastructure Engineer at Datadog; MS CS (CMU).

extraction_rules.rule_1_zero_hindsight: Extract metrics strictly as presented on the deck slides. Do not adjust for subsequent company outcomes.
extraction_rules.rule_2_explicit_nulls: If a metric is not stated on any slide, record it explicitly as null. Do not infer ARR from GMV or estimate churn.
extraction_rules.rule_3_units: Enter currency in nominal USD (e.g. $1.5M ARR = 1500000). Enter percentages as fractions (e.g. 75% gross margin = 0.75; 1.5% monthly churn = 0.015).
extraction_rules.rule_4_citations: Every disclosed quantitative metric must cite the exact slide number where the claim appears.
